segments.text: Compressed gas cylinders, major and minor leaks.
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶：重大泄漏与轻微泄漏。

segments.text: To help prevent leaks in your compressed gas cylinders,
segments.zh: 为了帮助防止压缩气瓶发生泄漏，

segments.text: remove rusty, corroded and damaged cylinders from servers
segments.zh: 应将生锈、腐蚀和损坏的气瓶停止使用，

segments.text: before they develop a leak.
segments.zh: 以免它们出现泄漏。

segments.text: Return cylinders when they are no longer used
segments.zh: 不再使用的气瓶要退还，

segments.text: or if they are more than 10 years past
segments.zh: 或者距离气瓶上所打印的上次检验日期

segments.text: the last test state stamped on the cylinder.
segments.zh: 已超过 10 年的气瓶也要退还。

segments.text: A minor compressed gas leak is a small, slow
segments.zh: 轻微的压缩气体泄漏是指少量、缓慢

segments.text: and controllable release of an inert,
segments.zh: 且可控地释放惰性、

segments.text: not asphyxiating or other low hazard gas.
segments.zh: 非窒息性或其他低危害气体，

segments.text: That poses a low risk of personal injury
segments.zh: 造成人身伤害

segments.text: or exposure.
segments.zh: 或暴露的风险较低。

segments.text: A major compressed gas leak is a large,
segments.zh: 重大的压缩气体泄漏是指大量、

segments.text: uncontrollable release of gas that constitutes
segments.zh: 无法控制地释放气体，

segments.text: a serious hazard to laboratory occupants,
segments.zh: 对实验室人员、

segments.text: facilities or the environment.
segments.zh: 设施或环境构成严重危害。

segments.text: A small leak in a toxic or highly hazardous cylinder
segments.zh: 有毒或高危害气瓶的少量泄漏

segments.text: is also considered a major leak.
segments.zh: 也被视为重大泄漏。

segments.text: If a minor leak is detected, notify people in the area.
segments.zh: 如果发现轻微泄漏，通知该区域的人员。

segments.text: If you have not already done so, don appropriate PPE.
segments.zh: 如果你还没有穿戴，请穿戴适当的个人防护装备。

segments.text: Determine that the leak is coming from the cylinder
segments.zh: 确定泄漏来自气瓶本身，

segments.text: and cannot be fixed by tightening connections
segments.zh: 而且无法通过拧紧接头

segments.text: or valve components.
segments.zh: 或阀门部件来解决。

segments.text: Then move the cylinder into a fume hood
segments.zh: 然后将气瓶移入通风橱、

segments.text: under a local exhaust canopy
segments.zh: 局部排风罩下方，

segments.text: or to an isolated, well-ventilated area to vent
segments.zh: 或移到隔离、通风良好的区域进行排放，

segments.text: if it is safe to do so.
segments.zh: 前提是这样做是安全的。

segments.text: If the gas is flammable or oxidizing,
segments.zh: 如果气体是易燃或氧化性的，

segments.text: remove any nearby and combustible materials.
segments.zh: 移走附近的所有可燃物。

segments.text: Evacuate the immediate area and post warning signs
segments.zh: 疏散紧邻区域并张贴警示标志，

segments.text: to prevent access by others.
segments.zh: 防止他人进入。

segments.text: Notify the laboratory supervisor and EH&S of the incident.
segments.zh: 将事件通知实验室主管和 EH&S。

segments.text: Remain outside the immediate area
segments.zh: 留在紧邻区域之外，

segments.text: until the cylinder contents have been exhausted.
segments.zh: 直到气瓶内的气体排尽为止。

segments.text: Return the cylinder to the supplier for needed repairs.
segments.zh: 将气瓶退还给供应商进行必要的维修。

segments.text: When a major leak occurs, including small leaks
segments.zh: 发生重大泄漏时，包括有毒或高危害气体的

segments.text: of toxic or highly hazardous gases,
segments.zh: 少量泄漏，

segments.text: evacuate the area and activate the building
segments.zh: 要疏散该区域，并启动大楼的

segments.text: fire or chemical spill alarm.
segments.zh: 火灾或化学品泄漏警报。

segments.text: Call 911 and EH&S to report the incidents.
segments.zh: 拨打 911 并联系 EH&S 报告事件。

segments.text: Provide emergency response officials
segments.zh: 应急响应人员到达后，

segments.text: with details of the incident upon their arrival.
segments.zh: 向他们提供事件的详细情况。

segments.text: Report all accidents, incidents and near misses
segments.zh: 将所有事故、事件和未遂事件

segments.text: to the ISU incident portal.
segments.zh: 上报到 ISU 事件报告平台。

segments.text: For more information about gas cylinders,
segments.zh: 有关气瓶的更多信息，

segments.text: check out the Gas Cylinder Safety Guidelines
segments.zh: 请查看下方链接的《气瓶安全指南

segments.text: manual linked below.
segments.zh: 手册》。

segments.text: If you have questions, please contact ISU EH&S.
segments.zh: 如有疑问，请联系 ISU EH&S。
